recipe.visualDefinition: A close-up portrait of a male figure in a baseball cap and white t-shirt, set against a dark, textured industrial background. The composition features a prominent weathered, orange-tinted paper label on the right side containing stencil-style typography.
coreVisualRelationships: Contrast between the clean white t-shirt and the dark, gritty background
Alignment of the text block with the subject's eye level
Texture matching between the background metal and the weathered paper overlay
Warm skin tones balanced by cool, dark metallic shadows
coreInvariants: Distressed, grunge texture applied to all elements
A rectangular paper-like graphic container with deckled or torn edges
Low-key lighting with a focus on facial features

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Subject occupies the left two-thirds of the frame, slightly off-center, in a medium close-up shot.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The subject's eyes and the bright white t-shirt at the bottom.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Starts at the subject's face, moves right to the text block, then down to the white t-shirt.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Dark, textured space on the right side behind the text block provides breathing room.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Deep browns and charcoal grays in the background and cap.
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Bright white of the t-shirt providing a high-value base.
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Muted orange and tan used for the text container and skin tones.
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: Low saturation overall with high contrast in value between the shirt and the background.

letterConstructionRules: Military-style stencil breaks in the strokes
Condensed proportions to fit within the label
Slightly irregular edges to simulate ink bleed on paper
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Single typeface family with varying scales to distinguish primary and secondary information.
graphicDevices: Weathered paper ticket/label with torn edges
Gritty vignette around the edges of the frame

candidateDirections.reason: Captures the rugged, military-style stencil look.
Provides the condensed, industrial feel required.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a portrait of a man in a dark baseball cap and a plain white t-shirt. The background should be a dark, scratched metallic wall with warm lighting on the face. Apply a heavy film grain and grunge texture across the entire image.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add a rectangular weathered tan paper graphic on the right side with torn edges and a thin double-line border. Inside the graphic, place two levels of text using a bold, condensed stencil font in a dark, distressed brown color.

verificationChecks: Is the stencil font distressed and weathered?
Does the paper graphic have realistic torn edges?
Is the lighting on the subject's face warm and focused?
Is the overall texture gritty and industrial?

mustRedesign: Exact wording of the original text
Specific facial identity of the artist

avoid: Perfectly straight edges on the paper graphic

postGenerationChecks: Ensure text is legible despite the stencil breaks.
Check that the white t-shirt doesn't lose all detail in the highlights.
Verify the grunge texture is consistent across the portrait and the background.
Confirm the paper graphic looks like a physical object placed in the scene.
recipe.reuseFormula: Combine a low-key rustic portrait with a distressed stencil-on-paper graphic overlay to create a rugged, Americana-inspired layout.
